# `08-pnl-margin` — P&L and Margin

| | |
|---|---|
| **Tier** | T0 |
| **Status** | `in-progress` |
| **Release approval** | manual |
| **Required gates** | `G0` `G1` `G2` `G3` `G4` `G5` `G6` `G7` `G8` `G9` |

## Purpose

Unrealized P&L, equity, used margin, free margin and margin level — the numbers that decide whether a client can trade and when they get liquidated.

## Depends on

- [`05-position`](05-position.md) — Position Engine
- [`07-pricing`](07-pricing.md) — Pricing Engine

## Depended on by

- [`09-risk`](09-risk.md) — Risk Engine

## Inputs

- positions
- quotes
- account state
- margin policy

## Outputs

- UPNL
- equity
- used margin
- free margin
- margin level

## What gets built

- equity = balance + unrealized P&L
- free margin = equity - used margin
- margin level = equity / used margin, with defined behaviour at zero used margin
- per-symbol and portfolio margin models as versioned policy
- multi-currency conversion with an explicit, recorded FX rate

## Invariants

These are executed as tests at gate **G4**. A module may not declare an
invariant it does not test.

- INV-070: equity == balance + sum(unrealized P&L of open positions).
- INV-071: used margin == sum(per-position margin) under the active policy.
- INV-072: margin level at zero used margin is defined and documented, never a division fault.
- INV-073: every P&L figure is reproducible from (positions, quotes, policy version).

## Test obligations

- boundary: zero margin, zero equity, negative equity, precision limits
- multi-currency accounts with FX moves
- historical replay against recorded market data
- price-gap scenarios (weekend gaps, halts)

## Known failure modes

The things that go wrong in systems like this one. Each should map to a test above.

- unrealized P&L computed from a stale or mismatched quote
- FX rate chosen at read time instead of recorded at computation time
